system.description: As a Standard Action, you can perform minor alchemical alterations to a Melee Weapon you wield. For the remainder of the encounter, you gain a +2 Equipment bonus on attack rolls with that Weapon. Additionally, once before the end of the encounter, you can sacrifice this bonus as a Free Action to gain a +5 Equipment bonus on a single damage roll you make with that Weapon.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
